prov.heading: Allowance for Credit Losses
prov.text: The ACL is an estimate of the expected credit losses for loans held for investment and for off-balance sheet exposures. ASC 326, "Financial Instruments-Credit Losses," requires an immediate recognition of the credit losses expected to occur over the lifetime of a financial asset whether originated or purchased. Charge-offs are recorded to the ACL when management believes a loan is uncollectible. Subsequent recoveries, if any, are credited to the ACL. Management believes the ACL is maintained in accordance with GAAP and in compliance with appropriate regulatory guidelines. The ACL includes

nonint.text: Noninterest Expense. For the three months ended September 30, 2026, noninterest expense totaled $5.1 million compared to $5.9 million in the three months ended September 30, 2025. Decreases in compensation and benefits of $652,000 due to lower staffing and lower expenses of the 2024 Equity Plan as well as a decrease in other expense of $106,000, primarily due to lower fraud losses, were the primary drivers of the overall decrease.

nonop.text: Interest Expense. Interest expense decreased $291,000 or 9.2% to $2.9 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 from $3.2 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025. The decrease in interest expense was primarily due to the pay-off of the subordinated debentures in December 2025, offset by an increase in the cost and average balance of deposits..

tax.heading: Deferred Income Taxes
tax.text: At September 30, 2026, our net deferred tax asset totaled $7.5 million. In accordance with ASC Topic 740 “Income Taxes,” we use the asset and liability method of accounting for income taxes. Under this method, deferred tax assets and liabilities are recognized for the future tax consequences attributable to differences between the financial statement carrying amounts of existing assets and liabilities and their respective tax bases. If currently available information raises doubt as to the realization of the deferred tax asset, a valuation allowance is established. Deferred tax assets and liabilities are measured using enacted tax rates expected to apply to taxable income in the years in which those temporary differences are expected to be recovered or settled. We exercise significant judgment in evaluating the amount and timing of recognition of the resulting deferred tax asset and liabilities. These judgments require us to make projections of future taxable income. The judgments and estimates we make in determining our deferred tax assets are subjective and are reviewed on a regular basis as regulatory, economic or business factors change. Any reduction in estimated future taxable income may require us to record a valuation allowance against our deferred tax asset.

net.text: Net Income. Net income was $3.4 million, or $0.42 per diluted share, for the three months ended September 30, 2026 compared to $3.7 million, or $0.41 per diluted share, for the three months ended September 30, 2025. Net income was $8.0 million or $0.97 per diluted share, for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 compared to $8.7 million, or $0.88 per diluted share, for the nine months ended September 30, 2025. The decrease in income for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 was primarily due to the $2.2 million first quarter executive transition expense and the related tax impact as well as changes in the provision for credit losses. The decrease in net income in the three months ended September 30, 2026 is primarily due to the $1.0 million credit to the ACL in September 2025 compared to the $0.2 million provision expense in September 2026.
